formats.name: HL7 FHIR R4
formats.implemented: Bundle export (Patient, QuestionnaireResponse, Observation, MedicationRequest/Statement, CarePlan, AdverseEvent, DiagnosticReport, ImagingStudy); import for selected resources into existing patient, idempotent by external identifier/hash.
formats.limits: Target FHIR server profile/terminologies must be agreed before production.

formats.name: DICOM Basic Text SR
formats.implemented: Generated Part-10 DICOM SR using local concept codes; report is built from the single stored encounter/assessment + linked observations.
formats.limits: Acceptance varies by PACS/viewer; validate against the destination modality and its required DICOM SR template/profile. A locally coded report is not an official diagnostic code.

formats.name: DICOMweb / PACS study references
formats.implemented: Import DICOM Study/Series/Instance metadata manifest or FHIR ImagingStudy and link by StudyInstanceUID. Image retrieval remains in the configured PACS/DICOMweb endpoint.
formats.limits: This local release does not implement a DICOMweb QIDO/WADO/STOW server or store pixel data; configure a PACS/DICOMweb endpoint.

formats.name: CSV/JSON existing databases
formats.implemented: Import structured diary rows idempotently using source system + external ID; JSON export/import for patient-scoped data.
formats.limits: Column mapping must be agreed; import previews/mappings are explicit to prevent duplicate records and overwrites.

formats.name: Android WebView + FCM
formats.implemented: Native wrapper source + WebView bridge and notification channel included.
formats.limits: Firebase project, google-services.json, server-side Firebase credentials and signed Android build are required for background push.
